evidence.why: Player query delegates to game helper.
Conditional cache refresh and team-dependent return.
Distinct calculation input and timer recipient.

facts.rationale: Preserves the exact signature and demonstrated timer role while removing the unsupported purity claim and distinguishing input fighter from timer recipient.
facts.value: Grab-duration calculation helper with exact signature float(Fighter* fp). It returns a floating-point value used for common grab-timer initialization and performs no direct Fighter writes. It is not transitively pure: Player_80033BB8 delegates to gm_8016C5C0, which may refresh cached game data. The supplied Fighter is not necessarily the timer recipient; Crazy Hand capture calculates from fp2 and initializes fp.
